_categories.DS: Directed-segment distance on the squared-Euclidean (non-metric) case40: the rule from De Caceres et al. 2019 eqs. 8-10 (with ecotraj's min-endpoint penalty) matches 39/40 cases; on case40 the corrected-triangle quantities used for the relative position / penalty differ from ecotraj's. DSPD inherits it.
_categories.NONMETRIC: Non-metric input (squared-Euclidean, Bray-Curtis): after the local additive triangle correction some triplets become collinear to the last bit, and ecotraj's output there (0, ~1e-6 deg, 180, or NaN) depends on its exact floating-point operation order, which black-box probing (about 60 candidate orders on ~14,000 crafted triplets) did not reproduce bit-for-bit. Reproduced: clamp on corrected triplets, NaN for d_ik = 0.
_categories.CONV_ROWORDER: trajectoryConvergence(type='multiple') on rows not sorted by survey: ecotraj's result depends on input row order (random permutations give different tau) but the rule was not identified (row stride matches 3/6 cases, first-appearance survey order 2/6); ours sorts by survey and equals ecotraj on sorted input.
_categories.SPD_ASYM: SPD with symmetrization=NULL (raw asymmetric matrix) on 3 of 40 cases: individual directed entries differ by up to 5%, although the symmetrized (mean/min/max) SPD values match ecotraj. Direction convention for some entries not identified.
